viewing_check: Check the cap and wire handle are original, how deep the rust on the top goes, and the base for pinholes or dents. I found no outside sale of this ATF-labelled tin: the eBay gallons sold recently are mostly the later ram-in-shield (Duo) design or the 1950s blue-panel design, and Burns & Co's plain 'Golden Fleece 1 gallon tin' results (A$100 to A$190, Aug 2025 to Mar 2026) don't say which design. Correction to an already-found entry: eBay 960082103383 (Supreme Motor Oil gallon, 18 Oct 2026) shows A$127.90 struck through with 'Best Offer accepted', so the price paid was lower and isn't shown in search results. eBay AU prices for private sellers include eBay's buyer protection fee.
